description: This file contains shell functions related to platform-specific upgrade procedures for a device, such as checking image metadata, performing upgrades, and copying configuration data based on board type.

methods.name: enable_image_metadata_check
methods.description: Checks the board name and sets a requirement for image metadata if the board matches specific patterns.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the current board supports system upgrade; returns success or failure.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade by writing the provided image to the disk device specific to the board.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration data to the appropriate partition based on board type.
